agents.name: locator
agents.role: LOCATOR AGENT (where the names are, before the rewrite)

agents.name: val_engine
agents.role: VALIDATOR ENGINE (build + tests on the delivered tree)

agents.name: final_pass
agents.role: WORKERS 3+5: CODE + TEST AGENTS (final pass on CD_Run)

agents.name: repair
agents.role: REPAIR AGENT (exact fix of a history leak, one rewrite round)

bottlenecks.title: final_pass is the critical-path bottleneck
bottlenecks.advice: Mutation + test changes + its own test runs. --max-repairs 0 and a smaller --max-verify-files shorten it.

bottlenecks.title: 87% of the run had only one agent working
bottlenecks.advice: Work that could overlap runs one-at-a-time. Check dependencies of these agents for something that can move earlier.

bottlenecks.title: Only 0.0% of input tokens were cached
bottlenecks.advice: The cache needs an identical prompt prefix and one working directory for every call.
